[ASSISTANT] Here's a summary of the extraction models available to your Maestro flow:

---

## Available IXP Extraction Models

The `configure-model` command surfaces the validated extraction models you can assign to an IXP project:

| Model Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `gemini_2_5_flash` | Google Gemini 2.5 Flash — fast, cost-efficient extraction |
| `gemini_2_5_pro` | Google Gemini 2.5 Pro — higher accuracy, more capable |
| `gpt_4o_2024_05_13` | OpenAI GPT-4o (May 2024) — OpenAI's multimodal model |

---

## Current Project State

Your tenant has **one IXP project** — **"Vendor Invoices"** (`vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp`) — with two published model versions, both trained on `gemini_ixp`:

| Version | Tag | Trained At | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **11** | 🟢 **live** | 2026-07-24 | Currently serving predictions |
| **5** | — | 2026-07-24 | Initial release, F1=1.00, 5 labelled docs |

---

## To Switch the Extraction Model

Use the `configure-model` command, e.g. to upgrade to Gemini 2.5 Pro:

```bash
uip ixp projects configure-model vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp \
  --model gemini_2_5_pro \
  --preprocessing table \
  --output json
```

The `--preprocessing` option (`none`, `table_mini`, `table`) controls intelligent table pre-processing and can significantly affect accuracy on structured documents like invoices.

initial_prompt: |
  ${row.prompt}

  Important:
  - The `uip` CLI is already available.
  - Use `--output json` on all uip commands.

success_criteria:
  # IxP registry-search check (omits `get`) — see routing.yaml for the pattern breakdown.
  - type: command_executed
    description: "Agent searched the registry for IxP node types (listing path)"
    tool_name: "Bash"
    command_pattern: '(?i)uip\s+maestro\s+flow\s+registry\s+(list\b|(search|list)\b[^\n]*\b(ixp|document|extract))'
    min_count: 1
    suite_thresholds: {mean: 0.85}

  # Inverted check: a listing/Q&A task should NOT create a .flow file.
  # `! find ... | grep -q .` exits 0 when no .flow file is found (PASS)
  # and 1 when one exists (FAIL).
  - type: run_command
    description: "No .flow file was created (listing is read-only Q&A, not a build task)"
    command: '! find . -name "*.flow" -type f | grep -q .'
    expected_exit_code: 0
    suite_thresholds: {mean: 0.85}

run_limits:
  max_turns: 20
  turn_timeout: 300
  task_timeout: 300
